subtopics.title: ShinyHunters Exploiting Oracle PeopleSoft via WAF-Bypass Encoding (CVE-2026-35273)

Impact Vector.text: Oracle PeopleSoft enterprise ERP systems exposed to the internet. Root cause: unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-35273) exploited via double URL-encoding and non-standard character transformations that bypass Web Application Firewall (WAF) inspection rules.

Exploitation Status.text: Confirmed active mass exploitation campaign by extortion group ShinyHunters (UNC6240), deploying web shells across dozens of corporate and public sector networks.

Defense/Mitigation.text: Apply Oracle's official Critical Patch Update immediately. Update edge WAF rule sets to enforce recursive URL-decoding before pattern evaluation. Restrict PeopleSoft administrative web endpoints to internal VPN access.

subtopics.summary: Oracle PeopleSoft enterprise ERP systems exposed to the internet. subtopics.title: WordPress Core Unauthenticated Path Traversal & RCE Exploited in the Wild (CVE-2026-87902)

Primary Sources.text: The Hacker News & Wordfence Threat Intelligence

Impact Vector.text: WordPress Core prior to version 6.6.2. CVSS Score: 9.8 (Critical). Root cause: unauthenticated path traversal and local file inclusion (LFI) in core script loading routines allowing attackers to include pearcmd.php and write arbitrary web shells under specific server and theme configurations.

Exploitation Status.text: Actively exploited in the wild within hours of disclosure; automated attack scripts observed conducting mass scanning against WordPress installations globally.

Defense/Mitigation.text: Upgrade to WordPress 6.6.2+ immediately. Block incoming HTTP requests targeting pearcmd.php and enforce DISALLOW_FILE_MODS = true in wp-config.php.

subtopics.title: Edge Normalization Defenses Against Differential Parsing WAF Bypasses

Engineering Takeaways.text: The ShinyHunters Oracle PeopleSoft campaign highlights the architectural hazard of single-pass WAF inspection. When reverse proxies forward double-encoded payloads (%252e%252e%252f) without normalizing them, backend application servers perform secondary decoding, executing path traversals that completely bypassed perimeter filters.

Architecture Strategy.text: Standardize HTTP request normalization across all edge proxies and API gateways. Configure load balancers to reject multi-encoded request paths before routing to backend application pools.

subtopics.title: Indirect Prompt Injection Hardening in Enterprise AI Workflows (SalesBleed)

Engineering Takeaways.text: The SalesBleed vulnerability in Salesforce Agentforce proved that untrusted input submitted through public web forms can hijack autonomous reasoning agents, leading to zero-click CRM exfiltration and anonymous Slack phishing.

Architecture Strategy.text: Implement deterministic policy engines between LLM agent outputs and execution tools. Require mandatory human approval for external communications and isolate untrusted form inputs from agent execution memory.

subtopics.title: Indirect Prompt Injection Primitives in Enterprise Agentic Workflows

The Core Threat Model.text: Autonomous reasoning agents integrated into corporate CRM and ERP pipelines processing untrusted third-party inputs.

The Novel Primitive.text: Contextual steganography and indirect prompt injection—embedding adversarial instructions inside standard web form fields that trigger only when an autonomous agent processes the record, hijacking the agent to extract confidential records via external webhooks.

The Broader Implication.text: Traditional input sanitization cannot prevent semantic hijacking; enterprise architectures must deploy deterministic policy engines that enforce least-privilege tool execution regardless of model output.

## ⭐ 30-Minute Priority Sprint: [ShinyHunters Exploiting Oracle PeopleSoft via WAF-Bypass Encoding (CVE-2026-35273)](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/shinyhunters-uses-waf-bypass-trick-in-oracle-peoplesoft-attacks/)
> High-severity threat vector with in-the-wild exploitation requiring immediate mitigation review.

## 1. 🔴 Critical Vulnerabilities, Exploits & Zero-Days
### [ShinyHunters Exploiting Oracle PeopleSoft via WAF-Bypass Encoding (CVE-2026-35273)](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/shinyhunters-uses-waf-bypass-trick-in-oracle-peoplesoft-attacks/)
- **Primary Sources**: BleepingComputer & Google Threat Intelligence (Mandiant) ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/shinyhunters-uses-waf-bypass-trick-in-oracle-peoplesoft-attacks/), [Google Threat Intelligence (Mandiant)](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/shinyhunters-renewed-mass-exploitation-campaign-targeting-oracle-peoplesoft))
- **Impact Vector**: Oracle PeopleSoft enterprise ERP systems exposed to the internet. Root cause: unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-35273) exploited via double URL-encoding and non-standard character transformations that bypass Web Application Firewall (WAF) inspection rules.
- **Exploitation Status**: Confirmed active mass exploitation campaign by extortion group ShinyHunters (UNC6240), deploying web shells across dozens of corporate and public sector networks.
- **Defense/Mitigation**: Apply Oracle's official Critical Patch Update immediately. Update edge WAF rule sets to enforce recursive URL-decoding before pattern evaluation. Restrict PeopleSoft administrative web endpoints to internal VPN access.

### [WordPress Core Unauthenticated Path Traversal & RCE Exploited in the Wild (CVE-2026-87902)](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/attackers-exploit-wordpress-cve-2026.html)
- **Primary Sources**: The Hacker News & Wordfence Threat Intelligence ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/attackers-exploit-wordpress-cve-2026.html), [Wordfence Threat Intelligence](https://www.wordfence.com/blog/2026/09/psa-critical-unauthenticated-path-traversal-vulnerability-patched-in-wordpress-core/))
- **Impact Vector**: WordPress Core prior to version 6.6.2. CVSS Score: 9.8 (Critical). Root cause: unauthenticated path traversal and local file inclusion (LFI) in core script loading routines allowing attackers to include pearcmd.php and write arbitrary web shells under specific server and theme configurations.
- **Exploitation Status**: Actively exploited in the wild within hours of disclosure; automated attack scripts observed conducting mass scanning against WordPress installations globally.
- **Defense/Mitigation**: Upgrade to WordPress 6.6.2+ immediately. Block incoming HTTP requests targeting pearcmd.php and enforce DISALLOW_FILE_MODS = true in wp-config.php.

## 2. 🏗️ AppSec, Cloud Architecture & Defensive Engineering
### [Edge Normalization Defenses Against Differential Parsing WAF Bypasses](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/shinyhunters-renewed-mass-exploitation-campaign-targeting-oracle-peoplesoft)
- **Primary Source**: Google Threat Intelligence (Mandiant) ([Google Threat Intelligence (Mandiant)](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/shinyhunters-renewed-mass-exploitation-campaign-targeting-oracle-peoplesoft))
- **Engineering Takeaways**: The ShinyHunters Oracle PeopleSoft campaign highlights the architectural hazard of single-pass WAF inspection. When reverse proxies forward double-encoded payloads (%252e%252e%252f) without normalizing them, backend application servers perform secondary decoding, executing path traversals that completely bypassed perimeter filters.
- **Architecture Strategy**: Standardize HTTP request normalization across all edge proxies and API gateways. Configure load balancers to reject multi-encoded request paths before routing to backend application pools.

### [Indirect Prompt Injection Hardening in Enterprise AI Workflows (SalesBleed)](https://labs.zenity.io/post/salesbleed-hijacking-agentforce-in-slack-for-anonymous-phishing)
- **Primary Sources**: SecurityWeek & Zenity Labs ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/), [Zenity Labs](https://labs.zenity.io/post/salesbleed-hijacking-agentforce-in-slack-for-anonymous-phishing))
- **Engineering Takeaways**: The SalesBleed vulnerability in Salesforce Agentforce proved that untrusted input submitted through public web forms can hijack autonomous reasoning agents, leading to zero-click CRM exfiltration and anonymous Slack phishing.
- **Architecture Strategy**: Implement deterministic policy engines between LLM agent outputs and execution tools. Require mandatory human approval for external communications and isolate untrusted form inputs from agent execution memory.

## 3. 🔬 Deep-Dive Research & Academic Papers
### [Indirect Prompt Injection Primitives in Enterprise Agentic Workflows](https://labs.zenity.io/post/salesbleed-hijacking-agentforce-in-slack-for-anonymous-phishing)
- **Primary Source**: Zenity Labs Research & COE Security ([Zenity Labs Research](https://labs.zenity.io/post/salesbleed-hijacking-agentforce-in-slack-for-anonymous-phishing), [COE Security](https://coesecurity.com/salesbleed-how-indirect-prompt-injection-could-turn-salesforce-ai-agents-into-a-data-exfiltration-risk/))
- **The Core Threat Model**: Autonomous reasoning agents integrated into corporate CRM and ERP pipelines processing untrusted third-party inputs.
- **The Novel Primitive**: Contextual steganography and indirect prompt injection—embedding adversarial instructions inside standard web form fields that trigger only when an autonomous agent processes the record, hijacking the agent to extract confidential records via external webhooks.
- **The Broader Implication**: Traditional input sanitization cannot prevent semantic hijacking; enterprise architectures must deploy deterministic policy engines that enforce least-privilege tool execution regardless of model output.

## 5. 🌐 Geopolitical Campaigns & Advanced Threat Actors
### [North Korean Cyber Operators Suspected in $351 Million Bitget Cryptocurrency Theft](https://www.securityweek.com/north-korea-suspected-in-351-million-bitget-crypto-heist/)
- **Primary Sources**: SecurityWeek & Bitcoin Foundation ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/north-korea-suspected-in-351-million-bitget-crypto-heist/))
- **Strategic Impact**: On September 24-25, 2026, cryptocurrency exchange Bitget suffered a massive security breach resulting in the unauthorized transfer of over $351 million in digital assets. Blockchain forensic analysis indicates signature TTPs consistent with North Korean state-sponsored threat groups (Lazarus Group / UNC1805) utilizing automated coin-mixing and cross-chain bridges.
- **Defensive Takeaway**: Financial and crypto institutions must enforce multi-signature cold storage quorum requirements, automated transaction anomaly circuit breakers, and hardware security module (HSM) rate-limiting on withdrawal contracts.
